rule.description: GitHub CLI operations MUST follow safety checks. Every issue MUST include mandatory footer. No exceptions.

repo-protection.check: Before ANY write operation (issue create/edit, PR create, comment), verify remote origin
repo-protection.error: Cannot modify template repository. Fork first: git remote set-url origin YOUR_REPO_URL
repo-protection.applies-to: gh issue create, gh issue edit, gh issue comment, gh pr create

mandatory-footer.rule: Append footer to EVERY issue body before gh issue create
mandatory-footer.no-exceptions: true — applies to all issues: epic, task, bug, documentation

patterns.pattern: Trust gh CLI — don't pre-check. Handle failure with: "Run: gh auth login"
Use --json for structured output when parsing
One gh command per action, keep operations atomic

violations.violation: Creating issues without mandatory footer appended
Writing to GitHub without verifying remote origin first
